title: Pull, Bull, Pull!
lines: Tim has a bag full of nuts.
He pulls it up a tall hill.
A big bull sits on the top.
"Go on, bull!" said Tim. No. It sits.
So Tim rolls a nut off the hill.
The bull runs and gets it.
Tim pulls the full bag to the top.
"You can have a nut," said Tim.

questions.ask: What is in the bag Tim pulls up the hill?
questions.listenFor: Nuts. It is stated in the story - if they cannot find it, have them reread the first line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Why does Tim roll a nut off the hill?
questions.listenFor: The bull would not move, so Tim got it to run after the nut instead. You want cause and effect, not just "it fell."

questions.ask: What do you think Tim will take with him the next time he goes up that hill?
questions.listenFor: Any guess with a reason. A nut moved the bull in line five, so nuts are good thinking.
